message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout just as dinner was about to be served. I quickly grabbed my trusty power bank and charged up my phone, which not only kept the music going but also let me check in on the weather. I pulled out my favorite lantern, and with some snacks from the pantry, we turned our kitchen into a cozy little picnic spot! It was a small win that turned a potentially frustrating moment into a fun family night. What’s your go-to trick for making the best out of a power outage? 😊
